# Adoption Matrix

| Actor | Use now | Do not claim | North-Star role |
|---|---|---|---|
| Congress | Enact benchmark/disclosure, governance, funding, and readiness gates | One algorithm is fair or constitutionally compelled | Enact exact feasible set and objective after validation |
| Commission | Publish benchmark, alternatives, COIs, final diff, and reasons | Benchmark replaces deliberation | Pilot exact certificates as comparison evidence |
| Court | Verify packages, order disclosure/reconsideration, select lawful interim plan | Hash verification decides legality | Evaluate exact certificate without delegating legal judgment |
| State staff | Precommit profile, maintain custody, run public process | Tract smoke is block conformance | Supply block data and operational constraints |
| Civic group | Submit COIs/plans, inspect diffs, challenge procedure and harms | Technical challenge is the only remedy | Test whether axioms omit representation interests |
| Researcher | Reproduce reference/ensemble evidence and attack methods | Internal panels are peer review | Build solver, bounds, and independent verifier |
| Journalist | Report evidence posture, failures, and source links | Percentile equals fairness | Explain axioms-versus-execution boundary |
